body:
What is Bitrefill?

Bitrefill provides products and services that allow anyone to live on cryptocurrency more easily. Bitrefill.com provides a catalog of gift cards and prepaid mobile refills that can be purchased using Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies worldwide. You only need to provide an email address to receive a receipt, voucher codes if applicable, and customer service.

What coins can I spend at Bitrefill?

​

Spend

Bitcoin (BTC)
Ethereum (ETH)
Dash (DASH)
Litecoin (LTC)
Dogecoin (DOGE)


Where can I use Bitrefill?

Bitrefill can be used anywhere in the world. Please go here for a comprehensive list of countries and supported payment methods in Edge.

​

How soon are the gift cards delivered?

Most purchases with bitcoin are delivered instantly as soon as the transaction is seen on the network. Other currencies may require network confirmations before the gift card is sent to your email.

What is the maximum limit?

There are daily limits depending on the gift card category, with some reaching as high as $10,000.

Order Status and Support

If you have any questions about your order or its status please reach out to Bitrefill directly at support@bitrefill.com
